security_audit.summary: The skill provides useful WeChat publishing automation but relies on powerful local capabilities: Chrome DevTools control, persistent authenticated browser profiles, clipboard access, keyboard simulation, filesystem reads and writes, and external process execution. Several scanner hits are false positives from regex parsing, SVG markup, CSS, and localhost checks, but the overall behavior still requires strong user consent and sandboxing. Static review was capped at 400/677 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 277 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Shell command construction in the agent-browser helper
remediation.suggestion: Replace execSync string commands with spawnSync argument arrays everywhere, and pass user-controlled title, content, selectors, and file paths as separate arguments.

remediation.issue: System clipboard and keyboard automation can affect the wrong foreground application
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before sending copy or paste keystrokes, verify the target window, and document the OS permissions required.

remediation.issue: Persistent browser profile can retain authenticated WeChat session data
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated profile directory, document where it is stored, and provide a cleanup option for users who want to remove session state.

remediation.issue: Markdown rendering may fetch remote images and PlantUML content
remediation.suggestion: Warn before remote downloads or external diagram rendering, and provide an offline mode that rejects remote URLs by default.

remediation.issue: HTML and SVG rendering paths can insert generated markup into the DOM
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize rendered HTML and fetched SVG before insertion, especially when source Markdown is not fully trusted.

content.value_statement: Publishing formatted WeChat articles often requires manual copying, image insertion, and draft setup. This skill automates draft creation from Markdown, HTML, text, and images through a controlled Chrome session.
actual_capabilities: Launches Chrome and connects to WeChat Official Account through local browser automation.
Converts Markdown articles into WeChat-ready HTML with selectable themes.
Copies images or HTML content to the system clipboard for editor insertion.
Creates image-text posts with title, content, and one or more local images.
Preserves a browser profile so users can stay logged in after QR authentication.
Can save drafts and optionally submit when the command includes submit options.
limitations: Requires Chrome or a compatible Chromium browser and a WeChat Official Account login.
Uses system clipboard and keyboard automation, so operating system permissions may block actions.
Depends on WeChat web interface selectors that may break after site changes.
Can download remote images referenced in Markdown, which may expose URLs to remote servers.

use_cases.title: Publish a formatted article draft
use_cases.description: Convert a Markdown article into WeChat editor content with title, author, summary, and inline images.

use_cases.title: Create an image-text update
use_cases.description: Prepare a short WeChat post with a compressed title, concise body text, and a batch of local images.

use_cases.title: Automate repeat posting steps
use_cases.description: Use Claude Code or Codex to run the posting workflow after reviewing source files and image assets.

prompt_templates.title: Post a simple image-text draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow with explicit title, content, and images.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a WeChat image-text draft with title "{title}", content from "{summary}", and images from "{image_folder}". Do not submit it.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Markdown to an article draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Article workflow from a Markdown file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert "{markdown_file}" into a WeChat article draft using the "grace" theme. Insert referenced images and save the result as a draft.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a reviewed campaign post
prompt_templates.scenario: Marketing workflow with source review before posting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review "{markdown_file}" and "{image_folder}" for missing assets, then create a WeChat draft. Tell me what was shortened or changed before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Run a controlled publishing workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with explicit safety checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the WeChat browser automation only after confirming Chrome is available and I am logged in. Create the draft from "{markdown_file}", keep the browser open, and do not click submit without my approval.

output_examples.input: A Markdown article with frontmatter, inline images, and the grace theme.
output_examples.output: A WeChat draft with a filled title, author, summary, formatted article body, and inserted image assets.

output_examples.input: A short title, 1,200 characters of text, and a folder of product images.
output_examples.output: An image-text draft with the title and body shortened to WeChat limits and images uploaded in sorted order.

output_examples.input: An HTML file exported from the Markdown renderer.
output_examples.output: The rendered content copied through the system clipboard and pasted into the WeChat article editor.

best_practices: Run the workflow in a dedicated browser profile and review the draft before submitting.
Use local image files when possible to avoid downloading remote assets during publishing.
Keep WeChat, Chrome, clipboard, and accessibility permissions visible during the first run.
anti_patterns: Do not run the skill on untrusted Markdown without reviewing remote image links and embedded diagrams.
Do not allow automatic submission for posts that need legal, brand, or editorial approval.
Do not use the clipboard automation while sensitive applications are frontmost.

faq.question: Does this skill publish directly to WeChat?
faq.answer: It can create and save drafts. Submission depends on command options and should be reviewed before approval.

faq.question: Why does it need Chrome?
faq.answer: The skill controls the WeChat Official Account web interface through Chrome automation and a local debugging connection.

faq.question: Can it work without logging in?
faq.answer: No. A user must log in to the WeChat Official Account page, usually by scanning a QR code.

faq.question: Does it use the system clipboard?
faq.answer: Yes. Some article and image insertion steps copy rich HTML or images to the clipboard and paste them into the editor.

faq.question: Can it handle remote images in Markdown?
faq.answer: Yes. The conversion script can download remote image URLs into a temporary folder before insertion.

faq.question: Is it safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: It needs caution because it launches browsers, runs external commands, uses the clipboard, and sends keyboard events.
